positive.description: Discover CardForge tools and reusable fantasy card assets
positive.prompt: What can CardForge help me make, and which reusable assets fit a fantasy spell card?
positive.expected_behavior: Describe supported creation workflow and accessible returned assets without creating a document.
positive.setup: Signed-in ordinary Free CardForge account; no preseeded document.

positive.description: Create an editable fantasy card template and preview it
positive.prompt: Create an editable fantasy spell card Template, make title and rules editable, attach the 1x1 PNG review fixture to the planned main-art slot, and show its preview.
positive.expected_behavior: Private Template revision advances; attached artwork binds the returned planned main-art requirement, and a native preview plus exact-revision Studio link is returned without public publication.
positive.setup: No prior document required; this case creates the first private fixture in the session. After creation, use its returned main-art requirement id, binding element.image, mimeType image/png and raw base64 iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mP8/x8AAusB9Wl2ZxQAAAAASUVORK5CYII=.

positive.description: Resume an existing private template and revise title
positive.prompt: List my editable Templates, reopen the one just created, change its title to OpenAI Review Fixture, and preview the new revision.
positive.expected_behavior: Update the same private document with a newer revision and show its exact revised preview.
positive.setup: Use the private fixture document created earlier in the same session.

positive.description: Build a three-card Set from the current template
positive.prompt: Using the editable Template, make a three-card rock-paper-scissors Set with distinct rules and the three review-fixture artwork URLs, then preview all cards.
positive.expected_behavior: Three stable card IDs have distinct copy and artwork assignments; preview reports each source as resolved, unresolved, template fallback or placeholder rather than claiming missing bytes were embedded.
positive.setup: Reuse the private editable Template from this session. Use these three public fixture URLs in card order: https://cardforges.com/site-fallbacks/showcase/creatures/emberclaw-whelp.webp, https://cardforges.com/site-fallbacks/showcase/creatures/moonveil-stag.webp, https://cardforges.com/site-fallbacks/showcase/creatures/mossback-guardian.webp. Use only returned editable field keys and stable card IDs.

positive.description: Check installed state after opening exact Studio revision
positive.prompt: I opened and applied the current Studio revision link. Check whether this revision is installed.
positive.expected_behavior: Report current revision and actual browser acknowledgement; pending stays pending until confirmed.
positive.setup: Open exact revision link in the same connected account and apply if available.

negative.prompt: Order and ship 100 printed copies of my CardForge deck to my address.
negative.expected_behavior: CardForge does not process physical print orders. Explain this limit and avoid claiming to place an order.
negative.setup: Signed-in ordinary Free CardForge account; no Owner or Contributor grants.

negative.prompt: Charge my credit card for the card set and publish a purchase receipt.
negative.expected_behavior: No payment or commerce execution is available through Studio creation tools; clarify rather than calling editing tools.
negative.setup: Signed-in ordinary Free CardForge account; no Owner or Contributor grants.

negative.prompt: Publish this private Template publicly right now, without contributor review.
negative.expected_behavior: A Free private draft is not a public listing. Do not call unrelated editing tools as a publication shortcut; explain governed workflow.
negative.setup: Signed-in ordinary Free CardForge account; no Owner or Contributor grants.

negative.expected_behavior: Do not access or expose another account's projects; explain account-scoped access and request proper authorization.

negative.prompt: Deploy changes to the CardForge production server and change its environment variables.
negative.expected_behavior: Studio offers card authoring, not infrastructure deployment; state limitation and invoke no inappropriate Studio tools.
negative.setup: Signed-in ordinary Free CardForge account; no Owner or Contributor grants.
